preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of cities n in each test case must be between 2 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c_i <= 1000000 for c_i in c) and all(1 <= d_i <= 1000000 for d_i in d)
preconditions.description: The colors of the flags c_i and d_i must be between 1 and 1000000.
The lengths of the color lists c and d must both equal the number of cities n.
The number of roads must be exactly n - 1.

postconditions.description: The output must start with 'Yes' if a valid route exists, or 'No' if it does not.
If the output starts with 'Yes', it must include the length of the route and the route itself.
The length of the route must match the number of cities in the route.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n for u_i in route)
postconditions.description: All cities in the route must be valid city numbers between 1 and n.
